name: ignis/php
description: The Ignis PHP userland, as packages. This root is the monorepo: it is not installed anywhere — install the package you need from packages/*, which is what the path repository below is for. Installing this root gives every agent one vendor/ with the dev tooling (phpunit, phpstan, php-cs-fixer, rector) for the whole tree.

scripts.lint: find packages tests ../examples ../bench ../scripts -name '*.php' -not -path '*/vendor/*' -not -path '*/var/cache/*' -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v '^No syntax errors detected' ; test $? -eq 1

scripts-descriptions.lint: php -l over every tracked PHP file (find, not git ls-files: git refuses to run in the container).
scripts-descriptions.stan: PHPStan level 9 over every package, then the 8.1 override for ignis/revolt. The memory limit is explicit because CI runs on the container php.ini default of 128M, which a parallel worker reached on 2026-09-18 and crashed the gate; a limit only the developer's php.ini supplies is a gate that cannot be reproduced locally.
scripts-descriptions.cs: php-cs-fixer dry run; run under the stock 8.3 php, it refuses to start above its supported max.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Dry run only — rector is a local one-shot tool here, never a CI gate.
scripts-descriptions.check: What CI runs: lint, stan, cs, test.
